an9.22:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] tayo ca bhikkhave, assakhaluṅke desissāmi tayo ca purisakhaluṅke, tayo ca assasadasse tayo ca purisasadasse tayo ca bhadre assājānīyo tayo ca bhadre purisājānīye.
an9.22:1.2: taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmīti. evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an9.22:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti, na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāha sampanno.
an9.22:2.3: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca na ārohapariṇāha sampanno.
an9.22:2.4: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an9.22:3.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaluṅko javasampanno hoti na vaṇṇasampanno hoti, na ārohapariṇāha sampanno.
an9.22:3.3: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti, vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāha sampanno.
an9.22:3.4: idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco purisakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti, vaṇṇasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāha sampanno ca.
an9.22:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave, purisakhaluṅko, javasampanno hoti na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāha sampanno:
an9.22:4.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an9.22:4.4: abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti, no vissajjeti,
an9.22:4.6: na kho pana lābhī hoti cīvara piṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ,
an9.22:4.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, purisakhaluṅko javasampanno hoti na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāha sampanno.
an9.22:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave, purisakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāha sampanno:
an9.22:5.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an9.22:5.4: abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti no saṃsādeti.
an9.22:5.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, purisakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti na vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāha sampanno.
an9.22:6.1: katañca bhikkhave, purisakhaluṅko java sampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāha sampanno ca:
an9.22:6.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
an9.22:6.4: abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṃsādeti.
an9.22:6.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, purisakhaluṅko javasampanno ca hoti, vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāha sampanno ca.
an9.22:7.3: javasampanno ca hoti, vaṇṇasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāha sampanno ca,
an9.22:8.1: katame ca bhikkhave, tayo purisa sadassā:
an9.22:8.3: javasampanno ca hoti, vaṇṇasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāha sampanno ca.
an9.22:9.2: javasampanno ca hoti, vaṇṇasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāha sampannoca:
an9.22:9.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyi hoti anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā,
an9.22:9.5: abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti no saṃsādeti,
an9.22:9.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, purisasadasso javasampanno ca hoti, vaṇṇasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an9.22:10.1: katame ca bhikkhave, tayo bhadrā assājānīyā:
an9.22:10.3: javasampanno ca hoti, na vaṇṇasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāha sampanno ca.
an9.22:10.4: ime kho bhikkhave, tayo bhadrā assājānīyā.
an9.22:11.1: katame ca bhikkhave, tayo bhadrā purisājānīyā:
an9.22:11.3: javasampanno ca hoti, vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāha sampanno ca.
an9.22:12.2: javasampanno ca hoti, vaṇṇasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāha sampanno ca:
an9.22:12.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an9.22:12.5: abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṃsādeti.
an9.22:12.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhadro purisājānīyo javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāha sampanno ca.
an9.22:12.10: ime kho bhikkhave, tayo bhadrā purisājānīyāti.
